title: coleus subspicatus
intro: Coleus subspicatus, commonly known as Coleus amboinicus, is a perennial herb belonging to the Lamiaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of fever, colds, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Coleus subspicatus include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include essential oils such as borneol, camphor, and borneol acetate, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
